thesis: One local-only VOICE practice core now has pitch/stability plus spectrum witnesses and can inhabit FIELD LAB PULSE without becoming another Lab mode. FIELD PULSE may lend tempo/beat while exercise authorship and microphone evidence remain local.
new: local-only microphone pitch estimation over a bounded 70–950 Hz singing range
single-note, 1-3-5-3, five-note and free-hum practice patterns
reference tone without recording or uploading microphone audio
cents relation, clarity and short-window pitch stability witnesses
optional FIELD PULSE consumption from LISTEN/AUDIO or FIELD LAB/SYNTH clocks
pattern steps may follow borrowed beat timing while exercise authorship stays local
bounded practice RETURN exports aggregate evidence only; never raw microphone audio
bounded FFT spectrum analysis beside the existing time-domain pitch detector
scrolling local spectrogram plus centroid and spectral-peak witnesses
FIELD LAB PULSE embeds the same VOICE trainer as optional detail instead of adding another Lab mode
PULSE beat may advance NOTE/CALL/SCALE/HUM targets while voice authorship remains local
LAB/VOICE RETURN contains bounded aggregate evidence only; raw microphone audio is never recorded or exported
constraints: VOICE is a consumer of FIELD PULSE timing, never an audio/source authority
external clock failure never blocks manual practice
VOICE is a consumer of FIELD PULSE timing, never audio/source authority
no speech recognition, lyric scoring, cloud inference or microphone recording in 0.2
LAB PULSE embedding does not move voice authorship into PULSE or LAB
